mechanism: Encode intraday seconds into MqlRates.spread as (def_MaskTimeService | macroGetTime(tick.time)) so the mouse indicator can read remaining bar time via iSpread(PERIOD_M1)&~mask. OnCalculate alone freezes under sparse ticks because rates_total only advances on new chart bars; the masked spread lets a service keep pushing time without a custom chart event per second.
data_needed: Tick timestamps; CustomRatesUpdate on custom symbol; mask 0xFED00000; iSpread(NULL,PERIOD_M1,0) on RePlay.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Custom RePlay symbol; test bars on PERIOD_M30; M1 spread channel; Forex/Exchange plot modes
why_new_for_mis: Turns bar-time remaining into a liquidity-aware clock that keeps updating when trade prints stop—MIS can sense thin-tape periods by watching whether real ticks or mask-fed synthetic seconds are driving the countdown.
quote: we cannot accurately report the remaining bar time in assets with (or during periods of) low liquidity.

mechanism: In LoopEventOnTime wait loop (~195ms sleeps), count iCycles 0..4 and call RateUpdate(false) every fifth cycle to st_Spread++ and republish masked spread. RateUpdate(true) on real ticks resets st_Spread from macroGetTime(tick). Approximates wall-clock seconds so remaining-bar display advances even when inter-tick gaps exceed 1s.
data_needed: Tick Δt_msc; ~5 service cycles/sec; CustomRatesUpdate; pause-aware wait so long gaps do not freeze control.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Low-liquidity Forex session starts (large early gaps); Exchange last-trade ticks; RePlay M1 rates
why_new_for_mis: Defines a practical sparse-liquidity sensor path: when synthetic seconds dominate over tick-driven resets, participation has thinned—usable as an MIS inactivity/density feature.
quote: if liquidity drops and there's a 50-second delay between ticks, the timer might slightly lead or lag.

mechanism: Set SYMBOL_TICKS_BOOKDEPTH≥1 on a custom symbol, then CustomBookAdd(MqlBookInfo) so OnBookEvent fires. Empty book→eCloseMarket; BOOK_TYPE_BUY_MARKET/SELL_MARKET→eAuction; else eInReplay/eInTrading. Unifies live DOM session-state sensing with replay by injecting dummy book levels (price/volume need not be meaningful).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Custom RePlay; test service on PERIOD_M30; live symbols with real DOM
why_new_for_mis: Shows how to carry closed/auction/continuous regime over a synthetic tape without a broker DOM—MIS can attach the same three-state gate to replay and live feeds.
quote: Without it, the CustomBookAdd function is completely useless for us.

mechanism: While replaying, accumulate iPos = Δtime_msc between consecutive ticks. If iPos≥60000 emit CustomBookAdd(BOOK_TYPE_BUY_MARKET) once (edge-triggered vs last typeMsg); else BOOK_TYPE_BUY. Maps ≥60s trade silence to auction HUD; play entry flips from auction to continuous; pause re-enters auction messaging. Author notes real auctions have regulatory rules—this is an intentional sparse-trade proxy.
data_needed: Tick time_msc series; 60000 ms threshold; ENUM_BOOK_TYPE edge compare; CustomBookAdd on RePlay.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: RePlay custom symbol; any chart TF; Forex and exchange tick tapes with long gaps
why_new_for_mis: Operational auction/halt proxy from inter-trade silence alone—MIS can flag liquidity-collapse/halt regimes on tapes that lack official auction markers.
quote: If the asset goes 60 seconds or more without a trade occurring, we will make the mouse indicator notify the user that the asset has entered auction status.
